name: Can a siding inspection detect moisture problems and hidden damage?

mainEntity.name: Can a siding inspection detect moisture problems and hidden damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a thorough siding inspection is designed to detect moisture problems and hidden damage. Inspectors use visual cues, and sometimes moisture meters, to identify areas where water might be penetrating or pooling behind the siding. This helps uncover issues like wood rot, mold growth, or structural damage that may not be immediately visible on the surface, preventing further deterioration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, inspections detect moisture problems and hidden damage using visual cues and tools like moisture meters to identify water penetration and its effects.
